text: The value of the integral $\int\limits _{-2}^{2}\frac{\sin ^{2}x}{\left [\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\frac{1}{2}}dx$ (where  [x] denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to x) is
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
I $=$ $\int\limits _{-2}^{2}\frac{\sin ^{2}x}{\left [\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\frac{1}{2}}dx$

$\mathrm{I}=\int\limits _{0}^{2}\left (\frac{\sin ^{2}x}{\left [\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\frac{1}{2}}+\frac{\sin ^{2}(-x)}{\left [-\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\frac{1}{2}}\right )dx$

$\left (\left [\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\left [-\frac{x}{π}\right ]=-1 \right.$   as   $\left. \begin{array}{l}  \\  \end{array}x\neq nπ\right )$

$\mathrm{I}=\int\limits _{0}^{2}\left (\frac{\sin ^{2}x}{\left [\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\frac{1}{2}}+\frac{\sin ^{2}x}{-1-\left [\frac{x}{π}\right ]+\frac{1}{2}}\right )dx=0$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot

text: If  $\int \frac{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}{x^{4}}$ dx = A(x)$\left (\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right )^{m}$ + C, for a suitable chosen integer m and a function A(x), where C is a constant of integration, then $(A(x))^{m}$ equals :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\int \frac{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}{x^{4}}$ dx = A(x)$\left (\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right )^{m}$ + C

$\int \frac{|x|\sqrt{\frac{1}{x2}-1}}{x^{4}}dx,$

Put  $\frac{1}{x^{2}}-1=t\Rightarrow \frac{dt}{dx}=\frac{-2}{x^{3}}$

Case-I   $x\geq 0$

$-\frac{1}{2}\int \sqrt{t}dt\Rightarrow \frac{t^{3/2}}{3}+C$

$\Rightarrow -\frac{1}{3}\left (\frac{1}{x^{2}}-1\right )^{3/2}$

$\Rightarrow \frac{\left (\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right )^{3}}{-3x^{2}}+C$

$A(x)=-\frac{1}{3x^{3}}$  and  $m=3$

$(A(x))^{m}=\left (-\frac{1}{3x^{3}}\right )^{3}=-\frac{1}{27x^{9}}$

Case-II  $x\leq 0$

We get  $\frac{\left (\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right )^{3}}{-3x^{3}}+C$

$A(x)=\frac{1}{-3x^{3}},m=3$

$(A(x))^{m}=\frac{-1}{27x^{9}}$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot

text: Let  $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+4\widehat{k},$ $\vec{b}=\hat{i}+λ\hat{j}+4\widehat{k}$ and $\vec{c}=2\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+\left (λ^{2}-1\right )\widehat{k}$ be coplanar vectors. Then the non-zero vector  $\vec{a}\times \vec{c}$ is :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\left [\vec{a}\quad \vec{b}\vec{c}\right ]=0$

$\Rightarrow \left |\begin{array}{lll} 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 1 & λ & 4 \\ 2 & 4 & λ^{2}-1 \end{array}\right |=0$

$\Rightarrow λ^{3}-2λ^{2}-9λ+18=0$

$\Rightarrow λ^{2}(λ-2)-9(λ-2)=0$

$\Rightarrow (λ-3)(λ+3)(λ-2)=0$

$\Rightarrow λ=2,3,-3$

So,   $λ$ = 2 (as   $\vec{a}$ is parallel to $\vec{c}$  for $λ$ = $\pm$3)

Hence   $\vec{a}\times \vec{c}=\left |\begin{array}{lll} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \widehat{k} \\ 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 2 & 4 & 3 \end{array}\right |$

$=-10\hat{i}+5\hat{j}$

text: The maximum value of the function $f(x) = 3x^{3} – 18x^{2}  + 27x – 40$ on the set S = $\left \{x\in R:x^{2}+30\leq 11x\right \}$ is :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
S = {x $\in$ $R, x^{2} + 30$ $-$ 11x $\leq$ 0}

= {x $\in$ R, 5 $\leq$ x $\leq$ 6}

Now $f(x) = 3x^{3}$ $-$ $18x^{2} + 27x$ $-$ 40

$\Rightarrow$  f '(x) = 9(x $-$ 1)(x $-$ 3),

which is positive in [5, 6]

$\Rightarrow$  f(x) increasing in [5, 6]

Hence maximum value = f(6) = 122

text: The outcome of each of 30 items was observed; 10 items gave an outcome $\frac{1}{2}$ – d each, 10 items gave outcome $\frac{1}{2}$ each and the remaining 10 items gave outcome $\frac{1}{2}$+ d each. If the variance of this outcome data is $\frac{4}{3}$ then |d| equals :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Variance is independent of region. So we shift the given data by $\frac{1}{2}$.

so,   $\frac{10d^{2}+10\times 0^{2}+10d^{2}}{30}-(0)^{2}=\frac{4}{3}$

$\Rightarrow$  $d^{2}$ $=$ 2 $\Rightarrow$ $|d|=\sqrt{2}$

text: If y(x) is the solution of the differential equation $\frac{dy}{dx}+\left (\frac{2x+1}{x}\right )y=e^{-2x},x>0,$ where $y(1)=\frac{1}{2}e^{-2},$ then
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\frac{dy}{dx}+\left (\frac{2x+1}{x}\right )y=e^{-2x}$

I.F. $=e^{\int \left (\frac{2x+1}{x}\right )dx}=e^{\int \left (2+\frac{1}{x}\right )dx}=e^{2x+\ell nx}=e^{2x}.x$

So,  $y\left (xe^{2x}\right )=\int e^{-2x}.xe^{2x}+C$

$\Rightarrow xye^{2x}=\int xdx+C$

$\Rightarrow 2xye^{2x}=x^{2}+2C$

It passes through $\left (1,\frac{1}{2}e^{-2}\right )$ we get C $=$ 0

$y=\frac{xe^{-2x}}{2}$

$\Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{1}{2}e^{-2x}(-2x+1)$

$\Rightarrow f(x)$ is decreasing in $\left (\frac{1}{2},1\right )$

$y(\log _{e}2)=\frac{(\log _{e}2)e^{-2(\log e2)}}{2}$

$=\frac{1}{8}\log _{e}2$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot

text: Let [x] denote the greatest integer less than or equal to x. Then $\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{\tan \left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )+(|x|-\sin (x[x]))^{2}}{x^{2}}$
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
R.H.L.  $=$ $\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{\tan \left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )+(|x|-\sin (x[x]))^{2}}{x^{2}}$ 

(as  x  $\to$  $0^{+}$  $\Rightarrow$  [x] $=$ 0)

$=$ $\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{\tan \left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )+x^{2}}{x^{2}}$

$=$ $\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{\tan \left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )}{\left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )}+1=π+1$

L.H.L. $=$ $\lim _{x\to 0^{-}}\frac{\tan \left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )+(-x+\sin x)^{2}}{x^{2}}$

(as  x $\to$ $0^{-}$ $\Rightarrow$  [x] $=$ $-$1)

$\lim _{x\to 0^{-}}\frac{\tan \left (π\sin ^{2}x\right )}{π\sin ^{2}x}.\frac{π\sin ^{2}x}{x^{2}}+\left (-1+\frac{\sin x}{x}\right )^{2}\Rightarrow π$

R.H.L.  $\neq$  L.H.L.
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot

sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

text: Two integers are selected at random from the set {1, 2, ...., 11}. Given that the sum of selected numbers is even, the conditional probability that both the numbers are even is :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Since sum of two numbers is even so either both are odd or both  are even. Hence number of elements in reduced samples space $= ^{5}C_{2} + ^{6}C_{2}$

So, required probability = $\frac{{}^{5}C_{2}}{{}^{5}C_{2}+{}^{6}C_{2}}$ = $\frac{2}{5}$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2019 (Online) 11th January Morning Slot
